comment: The raw colour classes test/unit/raw-colours.test.ts allows in the TSX files beyond the keep entries of the two codemod maps (scripts/codemods/semantic-colours.map.json and semantic-colours.status.map.json) that name their one string, which it reads rather than repeats. One entry per file and class, with the number of uses, so a new use fails the test and a removed one must take its entry down: the list only shrinks, but for the one time it grew, by the two entries WS02 step 5 planned for the About menu's gold, "You are here" and its row's tint, each held in its context by test/unit/goldText.test.ts, with every entry before them unchanged. A keep entry for a whole file or for every file allows nothing in the ratchet, so the classes those entries keep are counted here too: the translucent white veils on navy, which the step 23 map keeps in every file, and the print page's row rules and the dots, which the status map keeps for their files. StatusBadge's light tones and StatusDot's dot have no entry since step 26: the status map keeps each in its one string. Club colours, the swatches and the colours a club chooses, never appear here: they are user data, set as inline styles (the colour picker's placeholder #c8a94a on AdminClubPage.tsx and the swatch's fallback on AdminPage.tsx included), and no class is built from one. The gold text of the pages has no entry: step 25 moved the gold hex text classes (#7a5c00, #f0d07a and #8a6d1f) to the gold tokens, and test/unit/goldText.test.ts guards gold text from there; the one gold text entry is the About menu's "You are here", a use that guard places in its file, beside its words, at its size and on its ground.
